name: web-project-intro-slide-with-blue-highlighted-statement-and-stats
title: About-the-project slide with blue highlighted statement and three giant stats
whatItIs: A pale lavender rounded panel labelled 'About the project (01)'. A centred bold statement highlights phrases in blue, a small grey paragraph follows, and three large pale blue numerals (250, 28+, 120+) with tiny captions sit in a row at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Clear and factual; blue highlights and big numbers make credentials skimmable.
techniques: Highlight key phrases in brand blue inside a bold centred statement.
Show project scale with three big light numerals.
Keep the panel very pale with rounded corners.
Number the section in the top corner.

vocabulary.definition: A paragraph with key phrases coloured.
Three or four large numbers in a line.
